$comment: Website as a Funnel layer 3: the machine-readable tracking-state contract. Matt Barge approved the interim analytics owner, five completion definitions, 30-day dual-view attribution policy, and raw-plus-screened reporting policy on 2026-09-30. Version 1.0 records the live privacy-safe destination_key on production GTM version 7 and its event-scoped GA4 reporting registration without approving it as a completion join. Processed population, controlled reconciliation, destination instrumentation, verified joins, consent ownership, and key-event promotion remain separate gaps. A null event or join key is an explicit gap, never permission for an agent to invent one. Metrics are evidence snapshots, not permanent requirements. October 17 update: Matt accepted interim visitor-data ownership; historical instrumentation evidence below retains its original dates.

governance.meaning: The five completion meanings, attribution views, and raw-plus-screened reporting policy are approved. Observed events and downstream records remain separate until their join keys and instrumentation are verified. No event may be promoted to a GA4 key event without a separate approval after reconciliation. Matt is also the interim visitor-data/consent owner as of October 17; specific joins and data-policy changes still need a recorded decision.

views.meaning: Credit the earliest attributable eligible touch observed within the 30-day window.
Credit the latest eligible meaningful touch before the completion within the 30-day window. Direct-traffic handling remains part of the versioned screening and attribution implementation.

attributionPolicy.boundary: Approval defines the reporting views and window. It does not supply a join key, repair cross-domain continuity, identify a person, or authorize a key event.

trafficReportingPolicy.boundary: No traffic is removed from the raw view. Internal, automated, anomalous, consent-limited, or otherwise screened traffic is reported separately only after a versioned rule is approved and the excluded aggregate remains reproducible.

productionStartInstrumentation.versionName: Add destination key parameter to funnel CTA listener and GA4 tag

scheduledIngestionEvidence.meaning: Recent ingestion health only. Counts are starts, not unique people or completed outcomes.

productionStartInstrumentation.communityCoverage: The event definition is deployed, but the primary controls inside the cross-origin map.app.alpha.school iframe are not observable by the main-document listener.

destinationIdentity.routeHashInput: lowercase destination host without leading www plus normalized lowercase path without a trailing slash except root

authorityMappingCandidates.bookCall: Build an aggregate route dictionary from the governed HubSpot scheduling-link catalog by computing the same dk1 route hash for each public booking URL, then compare destination-key totals with booking totals grouped by hs_meeting_created_from_link_id. This mapping is a candidate until uniqueness and full catalog coverage are proven.
authorityMappingCandidates.infoSession: Compare the public Goldcast UUID in info_session:event:<uuid> with the public event identity represented by externalEventId or the governed event URL. This mapping is a candidate until controlled registration evidence proves it end to end.

ga4ReportingRegistration.meaning: The event-scoped custom dimension is registered and the GA4 Admin API verifies its display name, parameter, and scope. The first post-registration Data API read returned zero processed keys, as expected for a non-retroactive definition that may need 24 to 48 hours to populate. Registration is not population, reconciliation, a completion join, or a key event.

destinationIdentity.approvalBoundary: Live as a privacy-safe diagnostic event parameter. It is not an approved completion join key, a person identifier, a completed conversion, or a GA4 key event.
destinationIdentity.releaseEvidence: GTM version 7 was published through the supervised UI on 2026-10-01 after controlled preview passed for Homepage Info Session, Austin Book a Call, Austin Apply, and a legacy Goldcast registration route. Post-publish Tag Assistant showed one info_session_cta_click, one governed GA4 tag firing, and the expected info_session:event:99b076d6-61e9-4c3a-8196-2912b2bf254b destination key.
destinationIdentity.nextGate: Allow 24 to 48 hours for non-retroactive GA4 custom-dimension processing, verify aggregate destination-key population, and reconcile controlled start keys to the authority dictionaries before approving any completion join. The reporting service account remains least-privilege Viewer.

conversionDestinations.instrumentationPathCandidate: HubSpot Settings > Content > Pages > go.alpha.school > Integrations > Tracking integrations. HubSpot documents domain-level inheritance for hosted pages, but the specialized Meetings surface must be proven on one governed test scheduling page before release.
conversionDestinations.meaning: Discover a currently published governed Book a Call route from a canonical campus page, strip query and fragment data, and inspect that rendered destination rather than the domain homepage.

conversionDestinations.instrumentationPathCandidate: Goldcast organization-level Integrations > Google Analytics. Goldcast documents registration-page visits plus Open Registration and Submit Registration events; organization-level coverage must be canaried on a controlled test route and must not be duplicated with event-level scripts.
conversionDestinations.meaning: Discover a currently published public registration route from the canonical events listing, strip query and fragment data, and inspect that rendered destination rather than the domain homepage.

completionAuthoritySnapshots.meaning: These reads establish separate privacy-safe totals in the authoritative downstream systems. They are not website conversions and may not be divided by CTA starts until a governed join and attribution window are approved.

authorityIdentityCandidates.meaning: Distinguishes the governed HubSpot scheduling link that produced a booking. It becomes useful only if the same governed identity is carried by the website start or the primary property observes the verified completion.

sourcePreservation.purpose: Measure whether HubSpot integrations that create contacts preserve Alpha program context and the acquisition context required for later funnel attribution.

integrations.name: GT / Alpha Founders / External Apps Integrations

writeOriginAudit.meaning: For contacts whose UTM source is currently populated, inspect property history without requesting personal fields and distinguish a write by the creating integration near contact creation from a HubSpot form, merge, or later write. Current field presence alone is not preservation evidence.

proposedRepairContract.existingValuePolicy: Write only when the HubSpot property is empty; never replace an existing first-touch value.
proposedRepairContract.rollout: One QA registration, read-back, no-overwrite replay, scheduled integrity verification, then separate approval before another integration.
proposedRepairContract.rollback: Disable only the new Goldcast mappings or write action and revert only the QA contact if cleanup is needed; never bulk-edit historical contacts.

provisionalDiagnostic.meaning: A gap at or above this value is a measurement-debt finding, not a business KPI or an authorization to change production fields.

sourcePreservation.privacyBoundary: The scheduled audit requests aggregate totals only and writes no contact rows or personal fields. Passing GA client IDs, session IDs, raw email exports, or cross-system personal joins requires analytics-and-consent owner approval.

book_call_cta_click.nextStep: Reconcile clicks to HubSpot meeting bookings and prove cross-domain continuity before defining a completion or key event.

info_session_cta_click.nextStep: Reconcile clicks to event registrations and prove cross-domain continuity before defining a completion or key event.

info_packet_cta_click.nextStep: Define the authoritative packet outcome and separate a click, a served packet, a read, and later progression.

application_cta_click.currentMeaning: A governed main-document application CTA was clicked.
application_cta_click.nextStep: Identify the governed admissions destination and reconcile the click separately to application start and application submit.

video_start.nextStep: Verify video identity, page identity, and exposure denominator before reporting a start rate.

video_progress.currentMeaning: A video crossed one or more progress thresholds.
video_progress.nextStep: Document the progress thresholds and prevent multiple thresholds from being interpreted as unique viewers.

video_complete.nextStep: Join unique completers to unique starters by video and page, then test whether completion precedes an approved next step.

click.nextStep: Do not use as a conversion. Classify destinations and CTA controls first.

event_click.nextStep: Find the GTM trigger and parameter contract before using the event.

file_download.nextStep: Classify file identity and confirm which downloads are approved campus information packets.

popup_cta_click.nextStep: Document the popup, destination, eligibility, and outcome relationship.

workshop_click.nextStep: Locate the trigger and distinguish a workshop content interaction from an event registration.

hubspot_form_submit.currentMeaning: A HubSpot form submission was observed by the alpha.school GA4 property.
hubspot_form_submit.nextStep: Reconcile by host, form ID, purpose, and date against HubSpot before promoting any subset.

community_button_click.currentMeaning: A Community CTA interaction on the instrumented surface.
community_button_click.nextStep: Verify deployment coverage and destination identity before interpreting volume.

book-a-call.completionDefinition: A governed public or embedded HubSpot scheduling-page booking record is created.
book-a-call.doNotInfer: A CTA click, scheduling-page view, or scheduling-form analytics record is not a booked meeting.

info-session.completionAuthority: Event registration system and HubSpot Marketing Event registration
info-session.completionDefinition: A governed registration record is created in the event authority and represented through the HubSpot Marketing Event path.
info-session.doNotInfer: An event-card click or registration-page view is not a registration; integrations and event types must be classified before totals are compared.

info-packet.completionAuthority: Governed packet delivery system capable of confirming successful delivery
info-packet.completionDefinition: The correct governed campus packet is successfully delivered to the requester or visitor.
info-packet.doNotInfer: A generic file_download is not proof that an approved packet was requested, read, or acted on.

application.completionAuthority: Finalsite submitted-application record or the equivalent submitted record in the governed campus admissions system
application.completionDefinition: A governed application is submitted in Finalsite or the campus admissions system named by the approved destination.
application.doNotInfer: A HubSpot redirect-form submission, application-page view, application start, and submitted application are separate stages.

join-community.completionDefinition: A governed Community interest or join record is created in the Community system.
join-community.doNotInfer: A Community button click is not a completed join or interest submission.

knownGaps: No observed GA4 event is configured as a key event.
The main-document listener cannot observe the primary Community controls inside the cross-origin map.app.alpha.school iframe.
The Google linker currently lists alpha.school only; go.alpha.school and events.alpha.school are missing.

The primary GA4 measurement ID G-G7M04CYHH0 is not present on the real governed booking or registration routes. The inspected HubSpot booking route runs AW-11219766583 without the Alpha GA4 property; the inspected Goldcast registration route exposed no Google measurement. The outbound alpha.school links carried no _gl linker value. Adding linker domains on alpha.school alone cannot create continuity.

map.app.alpha.school exposed no primary GA4 measurement ID in the 2026-09-29 public inspection. Its primary Community controls require direct instrumentation or an approved origin-checked postMessage bridge; iframe focus is not sufficient evidence.
GA4 hubspot_form_submit volume is not reconciled with HubSpot submissions by host, form ID, purpose, and date.

In production run 36602327793, named integrations had Program currently populated on 94.65 percent of created contacts and utm_source currently populated on 0.10 percent. Property-history review found only one proven creating-integration UTM write in the 13 populated contacts; the other values came from HubSpot forms, merges, or later writes. Repair is governed by superbuilders/aeo issue 51.
The 30-day first-touch and latest-meaningful-touch views are approved, but no downstream completion has an approved site-to-system join key.

HubSpot bookings expose hs_meeting_created_from_link_id and Marketing Events expose externalEventId or eventUrl as non-personal authority identity candidates. Production GTM version 7 carries the governed destination_key on CTA starts, and the event-scoped GA4 custom dimension is registered. The first post-registration read returned zero processed keys because registration is non-retroactive and may need 24 to 48 hours; aggregate population and controlled authority reconciliation remain incomplete. destination_key is live as a diagnostic parameter and is not approved as a completion join key.
Matt Barge is the interim analytics owner; the consent owner and primary prospective-parent outcome remain undecided.
The raw-plus-screened reporting policy is approved, but the first versioned internal, bot, and anomaly screening rule is not yet approved.

trackingExpansion.scope: Exact control and exposure pilot; provider and sitewide component integration pending verification
